headlines.title: At least 7 Palestinians killed by Israeli forces over past 48 hours in Gaza
headlines.snippet: At least seven Palestinians were killed by Israeli forces in Gaza over the past 48 hours. Gaza's Ministry of Health reported that nine additional bodies were recovered from beneath the rubble.
headlines.title_he: לפחות 7 פלסטינים נהרגו על ידי כוחות ישראליים ב-48 השעות האחרונות בעזה

headlines.title: Iran promotes message of continuity and revenge at Khamenei commemoration

headlines.title: Russian attacks leave trail of destruction across Ukraine
headlines.snippet: Russian attacks have caused extensive destruction across various regions of Ukraine. The full extent of the damage and impact is still being assessed.

headlines.snippet: Yemen's health sector is critically weakened due to a significant brain drain. Many health professionals are leaving the country seeking better income and safer environments, leaving millions without adequate care.
